subject: Warning messages with survreg.fit not converging

messages.author: c7c5a2dae5228416
messages.subject: Warning messages with survreg.fit not converging
parts: Hi, when I run dataProcess on my data set, I get several warning messages about survreg.fit not converging.  I have tried to increase the iteration limit 3x (from 30 to 90) and still I get the same warning messages. I was wondering how I could deal with this issue?  Thanks!

messages.author: df9ba0266a9a081f
messages.subject: Re: Warning messages with survreg.fit not converging
parts:
You don't need to worry about this warning messages (It is not error message). It is already handled for final result.

Another 'warning' message for plots might be happened. You don't need to worry about that too. (That is about NA values, which are necessary for plot.)

Hope to help.

- Meena
